'''2006 Yavin IV Regional Brandon Ruck DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Ruck]] at [[2006 Yavin IV Regional]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brandon "Jabba_the_Ruck" Ruck (2006-05-08).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35550 Team TN Sim RalOps]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070922002211/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35550 Internet Archive]</ref>
